card.name: HIV drug labels, just before a name or number
card.fires_on: Small joining words, spaces or punctuation in HIV antiretroviral labels (Descovy, Biktarvy, Truvada, Triumeq). It fires right before a brand name, section number or table number.

modes.label: Linking word before drug name
modes.description: Words like 'of' or 'called' that come right before an HIV drug brand name.
modes.example: The recommended dosage<< of>> DESCOVY for treatment of HIV

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space or bracket before a table or section number in an HIV label.

modes.label: Inside a drug or term
modes.description: Partway through a brand name, abbreviation or hyphenated term in HIV text.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting spots in HIV drug labels where a drug name or a number comes next.
